(V. Lin). Let B be the braid group on n strings, and let n > 4.
                             n
    a) Does Bn have any non-trivial non-injective endomorphisms with non-cyclic
images?
    b) Is it true that every non-trivial endomorphism of the derived subgroup [Bn , Bn ]
is an automorphism?                                                        V. Shpilrain
  ∗ a) No, for n ⩾ 5 any non-injective homomorphism B → B has cyclic image
                                                            n     n
(F. Castel, Geometric representations of the braid groups, (Astérisque, 378), Paris,
2016, for n ⩾ 6, and L. Chen, K. Kordek, D. Margalit, Preprint, 2019, https://
arxiv.org/abs/1910.00712 for n = 5).
  ∗ b) Yes, it is true for n ⩾ 5 (S. Orevkov, Ann. Fac. Sci. Toulouse. Math., 33,
no. 1 (2024), 105–121, extending the result for n ⩾ 7 in K. Kordek, D. Margalit, Bull.
London Math. Soc., 54, no. 1 (2022), 95–111).
